title: 무너지는 숲
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE finished story-stage landscape illustration, without any title or lettering. Opaque wide 16:9 at the largest available landscape resolution, intended for downscaling to 640x360 and display at 360-480px width. Reference 1 is the game's painted pixel-art style anchor; reference 2 is its story painting style; reference 3 is this realm's palette, architecture and landmarks. All are reference inputs, not edit targets. Match the crisp visible painted pixel clusters and stepped silhouettes, rich but controlled colour, layered fantasy depth; no photographic or smooth 3D rendering. Cohesive nine-picture set rules: wide level establishing view, one dominant landmark centred horizontally in the MIDDLE THIRD, skyline/horizon around 70-74% image height in the LOWER THIRD, key environmental light from UPPER LEFT, midtone readability with dark blue-violet shadows, moderate saturation and contrast comparable to the other realms. Simple large shapes readable in a thumbnail. The outermost 3% on every side must be low-detail calm scenery safe for an 8px frame overlap, but DO NOT draw a frame. Keep the entire landmark in view. No people, human faces, humanoid figures, statues, letters, text-like decoration, glyphs, runes, numerals, logo, watermark, UI, borders or frames. No text anywhere. Stage 5, take A. VANAHEIM: a FOREST TEMPLE on a floating forest island, with living VINE BRIDGES connected to it. The island is visibly CRACKING APART, orange COLLAPSE LIGHT glowing from deep fissures in its rocky underside. Take A: front view of a single moss-covered three-arch temple centred at x50%; two thick woven vine suspension bridges arc out to modest side outcrops. Lower-third cloud horizon at y73%, temple floor at y67%, broken island underside below, a few falling rock fragments clearly separated. Emerald and deep teal forest with soft yellow-green daylight from upper left, vivid orange cracks limited to the centre bottom. Broad quiet sky above with light mist; the temple must dominate, no huge foreground trees obscuring it. Avoid faces in bark, idols, statues, symbols and letters. LAYOUT PRIORITY over the reference compositions: references supply style and realm identity only. Do NOT repeat their tall busy edge islands or high skyline. Keep the distant horizon unmistakably at y=75% of frame height, leaving the top 70% broad quiet atmospheric space interrupted only by the SINGLE central landmark. All secondary distant ground details remain below y=70%. No elaborate foreground objects at the edges. Main landmark base at y=76%, top near y=28%, visual centre x=50%. Calm outer 8 pixels after downscale.
